messages.text: Our office espresso machine is leaking. A wants a simpler one and B wants to keep the old one. I don't want a fight over coffee. Can you help us sort it out?

The leak worries me, so perhaps we should pause using the machine until it’s checked. Over the next two weeks, a dependable, low-upkeep option would help; the grinder could stay as it is if it’s safe and compatible. Maybe we could try a simpler machine without asking anyone here to take on repairs or a cleaning rota. I know the old machine matters to B, so I wouldn’t want to decide its fate now; ownership, costs and approvals still need checking.

The leak needs checking; I don’t want anyone using a machine that may be unsafe. Over the next two weeks, I need a reliable coffee setup, and I don’t have time for a long meeting. Pause use until it’s checked, then repair and keep the old machine; leave the grinder as is. The machine was our late father’s, but I don’t know who legally owns it now. Costs and approvals are undecided.

My main concern is getting dependable coffee without a dispute. For the next two weeks, I need a working setup and the grinder only if it’s safe and compatible. Pause use until the machine is checked; then consider the options. I don’t know the ownership, costs, approvals, or office rules. Items 1–4 look right as written.
Entries 24–33 seem reasonable to me. I’m afraid I don’t know who the right office contact would be.
Amend 29 to: “Do not decide the old machine’s fate before the check; repair and keeping it remain options.” I don’t know a suitable office contact.
I confirm entries 24–33, including the amended entry 29. I don’t know a suitable office contact.
Entry 29 looks fine, and entries 40–42 seem reasonable. I don’t know a contact name, but I’ll pass one along if I find it.
Confirm entry 29 as amended, and entries 40–42. I don’t know a contact name.
Please amend 40 and 41: The facilitator asks the normal office channel for a contact and shares the guidance when received. I can’t take the lead on contacting or following up. I confirm 42.
Entries 41, 42, and 47–53 look reasonable. I can’t take the lead on contacting the office or following up, but I’ll pass along any contact name I happen to find.
Confirm entries 41, 42, and 47–53 as written. I can’t take on the office follow-up right now; keep the safety pause until someone can contact them.
I confirm entries 39–51 as written. I can’t take on office contact or follow-up; the safety pause should remain until someone can contact the office.
Thanks for the update. I’ll pass along a contact name if I happen to find one.
Understood. The safety pause stays in place; I have no office contact to pass along.
